newsitem.title: USA: Sprint to offer toll calls in 10 states.
newsitem.headline: Sprint to offer toll calls in 10 states.

text.p: Sprint Corp said Tuesday it will offer local toll service to businesses in 10 states.
Local toll service, also known as intraLATA service, includes any call that originates and terminates within the boundaries of a single local access and transport area.

The company will offer the service first to Arizona, Connecticut, Illinois, Minnesota, Ohio and metropolitan New York. It said it will offer the service to Florida, Kentucky, upstate New York, Wisconsin and Michigan later this month.
The company said local toll service is available to its residential customers in the same 10 states.
